columns.audio_path: audio file, relative to the emotion_recognition/ folder
columns.acted_emotion: ground truth: the emotion each speaker was asked to portray (`emotion`)
columns.prediction: model prediction: the most probable of the 6 emotions evaluated (angry, fearful, happy, neutral, sad, surprised)
columns.prediction_all_classes: model prediction: the most probable of all 9 model classes
columns.p_*: model probability of each of its 9 classes (they add up to 1)

training_source: EmoBox academic data is used for seed fine-tuning, followed by teacher pseudo-labelling and data iteration to large; this project counts those corpora as used through upstream training. Large also uses 42,526 h of industrial pseudo-labelled audio. This is distinct from a claim that every EmoBox corpus directly entered large encoder self-supervised pretraining
